title: Design of a magnetic Fenton-like catalyst by decorating diamond-shaped MIL-88A with Chenopodium-derived biochar for nitrophenol degradation: optimization and mechanistic insights
content:

A magnetic Fe3O4/MIL-88A/BC composite was fabricated from BC, MIL-88A and magnetite for the catalytic degradation of 2-nitrophenol via a Fenton-like reaction.
